blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. As new tumor subtypes are introduced, extending existing MIL models requires learning new classes while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}, a class-incremental WSI framework that integrates multiple learnable queries per class with a shared prediction module. The queries aggregate frozen patch features into class-specific representations, while the shared prediction module limits parameter growth across incremental stages. By freezing queries associated with previously learned classes, EviSlide-MIL preserves their attention patterns for identical inputs, while experience replay and knowledge distillation further mitigate forgetting as shared parameters are updated. Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas demonstrate that EviSlide-MIL achieves improved performance and reduced forgetting compared with competing methods across most learning settings, demonstrating its potential for scalable and knowledge-preserving WSI classification. Code and pretrained models will be released.
blocks.zh: 全滑成像(WSI)的病理学分析在癌症诊断中起关键作用,多例学习(MIL)在薄弱的监督下被广泛用于WSI分析. 随着新的肿瘤亚型被引入,扩展现有的MIL模型需要学习新的课程,同时保留以前学习过的知识. 这是一种班级递增的学习挑战,模型必须获得新的班级,但获取历史培训数据的机会有限,并承认所有学习班级没有任务识别符号。 一个主要障碍是忘记,因为对特征汇总和预测模块的更新会降低以往学习课程的性能。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出\textbf{EviSlide-MIL},一个班级递增的WSI框架,将每个班级的多个可学习的查询与一个共享的预测模块相融合. 查询汇总了被冻结的补丁功能,形成特定类的表示,而共享的预测模块则限制跨渐进阶段的参数增长. EviSlide-MIL通过冻结与以前学习过的课程有关的查询,保留了对相同输入的注意模式,而经验回放和知识分馏则随着共享参数的更新而进一步减轻了遗忘. 对来自"癌症基因组图集"的8个肿瘤亚型的实验表明,与大多数学习环境的相竞争方法相比,EviSlide-MIL实现了更好的性能并减少了遗忘,证明了其可扩展性和知识保存WSI分类的潜力. 代码和预训模型将发布.

blocks.en: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis is crucial in computational pathology, enabling automated tumor classification from digitized histopathology slides. Due to the gigapixel resolution of WSIs and the limited availability of detailed annotations, multiple instance learning (MIL) has become a widely adopted approach for WSI analysis [ 1 , 2 ] . MIL models typically aggregate features extracted from tissue patches to identify discriminative patterns under slide-level supervision. However, as new tumor subtypes are introduced, conventional MIL models often require retraining on previously collected data. In practice, storing and revisiting all historical patient data may be impractical due to storage and privacy constraints. This motivates class-incremental learning, where models sequentially acquire new classes with limited access to earlier data while recognizing all previously learned classes without task identifiers at inference.
blocks.zh: 全滑图象(WSI)分析在计算病理学中至关重要,能够从数字化的组织病理学幻灯片中自动进行肿瘤分类. 由于WSI的千兆像素分辨率和详细说明的提供有限,多种实例学习(MIL)已经成为WSI分析的一种广泛采用的方法[1,2]. MIL模型一般是从组织补丁中提取的聚合特征,以在滑动层的监督下识别歧视模式. 然而,随着新的肿瘤亚型的引入,常规的MIL模型往往需要根据以前收集的数据进行再培训. 在实践中,由于存储和隐私的限制,储存和重访所有历史病人数据可能不切实际。 这激发了班级的递增学习,模型依次获得新的班级,但获取早期数据的机会有限,同时在推论中承认所有以前学习的班级没有任务识别符.

blocks.en: Class-incremental learning must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned classes [ 3 ] . Existing continual MIL methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through experience replay and knowledge distillation [ 4 , 5 ] . However, WSI classification requires preserving both tissue evidence aggregation and class discrimination as new tumor subtypes emerge (Fig. 1 ). Although class-specific attention and query-based aggregation offer flexible representations [ 2 , 6 ] , three challenges remain.
blocks.zh: 强化班级学习必须获得新知识,同时保留以前学习的班级 [3]. 现有的持续的MIL方法通过经验重现和知识蒸馏减轻灾难性的遗忘[4,5]. 然而,随着新的肿瘤亚型的出现(图1),WSI的分类要求同时保留组织证据聚合和分类歧视. 虽然具体类别的关注和基于查询的汇总提供了灵活的表述[2,6],但仍有三个挑战。

blocks.en: Instability of class-specific evidence aggregation. MIL models rely on attention-based aggregation to identify informative tissue regions for slide-level predictions. During incremental learning, updating shared aggregation parameters for new tumor subtypes can alter the attention assigned to patches associated with earlier classes. Previously learned representations may drift even when the underlying patch features remain unchanged. Although attention distillation can constrain such changes [ 5 ] , maintaining class-specific evidence while learning discriminative representations for new subtypes remains an important challenge.
blocks.zh: 分类具体证据汇总不稳定. MIL模型依靠基于注意力的聚合来识别信息化组织区域进行滑行级预测. 在增量学习过程中,更新新肿瘤亚型的共享聚合参数,可以改变分配给与早期类相关的补丁的注意力. 以前学到的表述即使基本补丁特征保持不变,也可能漂移。 虽然注意力分馏可以制约这种变化[5],但是在学习对新亚型的歧视性表述的同时,保持特定阶级的证据仍然是一个重要的挑战.

blocks.en: Interference in shared class prediction. Preserving earlier attention patterns does not necessarily preserve classification performance. Even with fixed patch aggregation, updating the prediction function to accommodate new classes can change the scores assigned to previously learned subtypes. Moreover, introducing new candidate classes increases competition during inference, potentially reducing the relative confidence of earlier classes. This distinction between aggregation and prediction makes forgetting difficult to address through attention preservation alone.
blocks.zh: 干扰共享类预测. 保留早期的注意模式不一定能保持分类性能. 即使有固定的补丁聚合,更新预测功能以适应新的类,也可以改变分配给先前学习过的子类型的分数. 此外,引入新的考生班会增加推论期间的竞争,有可能降低早期班的相对信心. 这种汇总和预测之间的区别使得人们难以仅仅通过注意保留来解决遗忘问题。

blocks.en: Balancing incremental adaptability and parameter efficiency. A class-incremental MIL framework should accommodate an expanding set of tumor subtypes without excessive model growth. Assigning independent aggregation and prediction modules to each class can increase parameter requirements as new classes arrive. Conversely, extensively sharing parameters across classes may introduce interference between previously learned and newly acquired knowledge. Limited access to historical patient data further complicates this trade-off, motivating architectures that support class-specific representation learning while maintaining a compact shared prediction mechanism.
blocks.zh: 平衡增量适应性和参数效率. 分类递增的MIL框架应当容纳一组扩大的肿瘤亚型,而不会出现过度的模型生长. 将独立的汇总和预测模块分配给每个类,可以随着新类的到来而增加参数要求. 反之,各阶级之间广泛分享参数,可能会在以前学到的知识与新获得的知识之间造成干扰。 获取历史病人数据的机会有限,使这种权衡更为复杂,促使人们在维持紧凑的共享预测机制的同时,支持特定阶层的表述学习。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose EviSlide-MIL , a class-incremental WSI framework designed to learn new tumor subtypes while preserving previously acquired knowledge and controlling parameter growth. The framework integrates class-specific evidence aggregation, parameter-efficient prediction, and knowledge retention to support incremental learning.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用EviSlide-MIL——一种级递增的WSI框架,旨在学习新的肿瘤亚型,同时保留以前获得的知识和控制参数生长。 该框架整合了具体类别的证据汇总,参数高效的预测,以及知识保留,以支持渐进学习.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose a decoupled architecture that employs multi-query class-specific aggregation to extract evidence from frozen patch features, with a shared prediction module to score the resulting class representations. • To mitigate representation drift and parameter growth, we freeze queries associated with previously learned classes. Each new class introduces only its own queries and a class-specific bias, preserving historical attention patterns for identical inputs while limiting additional parameters. • To balance adaptation and retention, we integrate experience replay and knowledge distillation . Replayed patch features maintain supervision for previously learned classes, while distillation encourages consistency with earlier predictions and reduces forgetting. • Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas [ 7 ] demonstrate improved classification performance and reduced catastrophic forgetting across most evaluated settings. Additional experiments with GigaPath features [ 8 ] examine query multiplicity, prediction sharing, query freezing, and retention strategies.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multiple Instance Learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 多实例学习

blocks.en: Multiple instance learning (MIL) predicts bag-level labels from sets of instances without instance-level annotations [ 9 ] . ABMIL replaces fixed pooling with learned instance weights [ 1 ] . CLAM introduces class-specific attention and instance clustering [ 2 ] , while TransMIL models morphological and spatial dependencies among patches through Transformer-based aggregation [ 10 ] . PANTHER models distributions of morphological prototypes for unsupervised slide representation learning [ 11 ] . More recently, pathology foundation models such as CONCH and GigaPath provide transferable representations for downstream analysis [ 12 , 8 ] . These advances improve feature extraction and bag aggregation, but do not directly address incremental learning of new tumor subtypes.
blocks.zh: 多例学习(MIL)预言从几组例中产生的包级标签,没有例级说明[9]. ABMIL用学习实例权重取代固定集合 [1]. CLAM引入了特定类的注意和实例集群[2],而跨MIL模型则通过基于变形器的聚合[10]在补丁间形成形态学和空间依赖性. PANTHER模型 形态原型的分布,用于无监督的幻灯片表达学习 [11]. 最近,CONCH和Gigapath等病理基础模型为下游分析提供了可转移的表示[12,8]. 这些进步改善了特征提取和包集,但并不直接涉及新肿瘤亚型的增量学习.

blocks.en: 2.2 Query Pooling
blocks.zh: 2.2 查询池

blocks.en: Query pooling aggregates variable-sized sets of input features into compact representations using learnable queries. Deep Sets establishes permutation-invariant set representations through shared transformations and sum pooling [ 13 ] . Set Transformer introduces pooling by multihead attention with learnable seed vectors [ 14 ] , while Perceiver uses latent queries to aggregate high-dimensional inputs [ 15 ] . Query2Label employs label queries to extract class-related features through cross-attention, followed by class-specific prediction heads [ 16 ] . For incremental WSI classification, QPMIL-VL combines queryable prototype aggregation with enhanced class-text representations [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 查询集集将可变大小的一组输入特征集中到使用可学习查询的紧凑表达中. 深处 Sets通过共享转换和总和集合[13]来建立演化-变量集表达. Set Transformer引入了多头关注与可学习种子矢量的集合[14],而Perceiver则使用潜在查询来聚合高维输入[15]. Query2Label使用标签查询通过交叉注意来提取与类相关的特征,然后是类特定预测头[16]. 对于递增的WSI分类,QPMIL-VL将可查询的原型聚合与增强的类文本表示[6].

blocks.en: 2.3 Continual Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 继续学习

blocks.en: Continual learning aims to acquire new classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, often through experience replay and knowledge distillation [ 17 , 3 ] . Bias correction addresses predictions skewed toward newly introduced classes [ 18 ] . For WSI analysis, ConSlide combines hierarchical modeling with breakup–reorganize rehearsal [ 4 ] . AKD preserves attention knowledge, while PMP retains informative patches for replay [ 5 ] . More recent approaches include KMP-MIL, which employs parameterized knowledge memory [ 19 ] , and CooMIL, which adopts context-guided prompt learning [ 20 ] . CoMEL extends continual MIL to tumor localization [ 21 ] , while MergeSlide merges models with task-to-class prompt-aligned inference [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 继续学习的目的是获得新的课程,同时减轻灾难性的遗忘,往往通过经验回放和知识蒸馏[17,3]. 偏执的校正涉及向新引入的类别倾斜的预测 [18]. 对于WSI分析,康斯利德将分级建模与分解合并——重组排练[4]. AKD保存关注知识,而PMP则保留信息补丁供重播[5]. 最近的办法包括采用参数化知识内存的KMP-MIL和采用上下文指导的即时学习的CooMIL。 CoMEL将连续的MIL延伸至肿瘤局部化[21],而MergeSlide则将模型与任务到类的快速对齐推论[22]合并.

Historical data are restricted to bounded replay memory. Only slide labels supervise aggregation [ 23 , 24 ] . Patch annotations are unnecessary.

EviSlide-MIL separates class-specific aggregation from shared prediction (Fig. 2 ). A frozen encoder supplies patch features, and multiple queries per class produce weighted slide summaries. A shared projection combines each summary with its query and match strength. Mean aggregation, a shared scoring vector and class biases then yield a softmax over all seen classes without organ or task identifiers.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate eight TCGA subtypes [ 7 ] in four two-class stages: lung (LUAD/LUSC), breast (IDC/ILC), renal (KIRC/KICH) and esophageal (EAC/ESCC). Reverse order inverts these organ pairs. Training uses slide labels and inherited patient-disjoint training/validation partitions. Each configuration covers folds 2–5, two orders and two prescribed seeds: 16 trajectories over 1,223 distinct validation patients. The held-out comparison uses 379 additional patients (394 slides), disjoint from the full 1,523-patient development pool. Its analysis plan and all 128 stage checkpoints were fixed before test access.

blocks.en: Tab. 1 compares EviSlide-MIL with attention-based MIL (ABMIL [ 1 ] , CLAM [ 2 ] ), TransMIL [ 10 ] , pseudo-bag replay (PMP [ 5 ] ), vision–language continual MIL (QPMIL-VL [ 6 ] , KMP-MIL [ 19 ] ), context-guided CooMIL [ 20 ] and hierarchical ConSlide [ 4 ] .

blocks.en: EviSlide-MIL achieved the highest mean final F1 in three of four input/training groups. With GigaPath, it reached 77.80% F1, outperforming CLAM-SB with AKD [ 2 ] by 5.12 pp, while improving old recall by 4.97 pp and reducing forgetting by 6.24 pp. With projected CONCH, it achieved 81.10% F1, exceeding QPMIL-VL [ 6 ] and KMP-MIL [ 19 ] by 3.40 and 10.73 pp, respectively, with the strongest old-class retention. Under ConvNeXt training, it surpassed ConSlide [ 4 ] by 10.31 pp in F1 and reduced forgetting by 17.05 pp, despite lower new recall (60.86% versus 80.18%). However, CooMIL [ 20 ] led hierarchical CONCH (86.78% versus 78.12% F1), leveraging additional parent context, text, task specialists and class masking. In contrast, EviSlide-MIL scores all seen classes without task identifiers. These results highlight its retention advantage and the trade-off with new-class acquisition.
blocks.zh: EviSlide-MIL在四个投入/培训小组中的三个小组中实现了最高的中间最终F1。 与Gigapath公司相比,它达到了77.80%的F1,在5.12页前与AKD公司相比CLAM-SB公司表现优异,同时在4.97页前改进了旧的召回,并减少了6.24页的遗忘. 在预计的CONCH下,它分别以3.40和10.73pp的成绩达到81.10%的F1,超过了QPMIL-VL[6]和KMP-MIL[19],并保持了最强的旧级。 在ConvNEXt训练下,尽管新的召回率较低(60.86%对80.18%),但是在F1中它比ConSlide[4]多出10.31页,而忘记的却少出17.05页。 然而,CooMIL[20]领导了分级CONCH(86.78%对78.12%的F1),利用了额外的父环境、文本、任务专家和班级遮掩。 相比之下,EviSlide-MIL的分数都是没有任务标识的所见类. 这些结果突出了其保留优势和与新级收购的权衡.

blocks.en: 4.4 Held-out Classification and Retention
blocks.zh: 4.4 被搁置的分类和保留

blocks.en: The held-out evaluation tests whether the retention advantage extends to unseen patients, a key check on the stability of incremental predictions. On 379 held-out TCGA patients, with the analysis plan and checkpoints fixed before test access, EviSlide-MIL achieved 75.84% macro-F1 versus 63.27% for ABMIL with Replay/KD (Tab. 2 ). The paired gain was 12.57 pp (95% CI, 10.14–15.16), with positive gains in both orders. Old recall increased from 66.02% to 77.96%, while new recall remained similar (91.22% versus 90.83%). Forgetting fell by 12.42 pp (95% CI, 9.90–15.39), linking the improvement mainly to retention of earlier subtypes. Substantial errors remained in vulnerable old classes. Forward-order LUAD/LUSC recalls were 52.38%/30.00%, versus 33.93%/6.67% for ABMIL; reverse-order ESCC recall was 55.36% versus 14.29%. Thus, better aggregate retention did not eliminate subtype-specific forgetting.
blocks.zh: 搁置的评价测试保留优势是否延伸到了看不见的病人,这是对增量预测稳定性的关键检查. 在379名被扣留的TCGA病人中,在测试前确定了分析计划和检查点,EviSlide-MIL实现了75.84%的宏观-F1,而ABMIL则实现了63.27%的反弹/KD(第2段)。 配对收益为12.57pp(95%CI,10.14–15.16),在两种订单中都有正面收益. 旧召回率从66.02%上升到77.96%,而新的召回率仍然相似(91.22%对90.83%)。 遗忘下降了12.42页(95% CI, 9.90–15.39),将改进主要与保留早期的子类型联系起来. 在脆弱的老班级中仍然存在着重大错误。 前置订单LUAD/LUSC ABMIL的召回率为52.38%/30.0%,而ABMIL的召回率为33.93%/6.67%;反序ESCC召回率为55.36%/14.29%。 因此,更好的总留存并不能消除特定亚类型的遗忘。

blocks.en: 4.5 Attention Visualization
blocks.zh: 4.5 注意视觉

blocks.en: We visualize class-specific query attention to examine how multiple queries distribute evidence within a slide, making their aggregation behavior interpretable. Fig. 4 shows ground-truth-class attention in selected correctly classified LUSC and LUAD cases. In LUSC, Q1, Q2 and Q4 emphasize overlapping central regions, while Q3 spreads attention more broadly. In LUAD, Q1/Q2 share a maximum, whereas Q3/Q4 peak elsewhere. The lower images provide spatial context, revealing variations in cellular density, nuclear morphology and tissue organization across the attended regions. These patterns highlight two complementary behaviors: overlapping queries reinforce shared morphological evidence, while spatially distinct queries capture additional tissue characteristics. Notably, this diversity emerges without explicit constraints on query specialization. By combining shared and complementary attention, multi-query pooling can integrate multiple morphological patterns and better represent tissue heterogeneity within a slide.
blocks.zh: 我们可视化特定类的查询注意力,以检查多个查询如何在幻灯片中分配证据,使其聚合行为可以解释. 图4显示了在选定的正确分类的LUSC和LUAD案件中的地面-真相类关注。 在LUSC,Q1,Q2和Q4中强调重叠的中心区域,而Q3则更广泛地分散注意力. 在LUAD中,Q1/Q2共享上限,而Q3/Q4则在其他地方达到峰值. 下层图像提供空间背景,揭示各覆盖区域细胞密度、核形态和组织组织的变化。 这些规律突出了两个互补的行为:重叠的询问强化了共享的形态学证据,而空间差异的询问则捕捉到额外的组织特征. 值得注意的是,这种多样性的出现对查询的专门性没有明显的限制。 通过将共享和互补的注意力结合起来,多query集合可以整合多种形态形态,更好地代表幻灯片中的组织异质性.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Multi-query Pooling and Shared Prediction
blocks.zh: 5.1 多管池和共用预测

blocks.en: We first investigate how multi-query pooling and shared prediction contribute to incremental learning performance. Fig. 5 shows that four queries improved F1 by 1.84 pp over one query, with gains in 14 of 16 conditions, supporting multiple-view aggregation [ 6 ] . Shared prediction reached 77.80% F1 versus 71.70% for private width-32 branches at the same final 1.23M-parameter budget. Private width 256 increased size to 9.49M and reached 75.27%. Together, these results highlight the complementary benefits of multi-query aggregation and shared prediction: the former enriches slide-level representations, while the latter achieves stronger classification with greater parameter efficiency than class-specific predictors.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查多管结合和共同预测如何有助于逐步学习。 图5显示,4个查询比1个查询改进了F1,比1.84页,在16个条件中的14个条件有增益,支持多视图汇总[6]. 在同一个最终的1.23M参数预算下,对私人宽度-32分支的共享预测达到77.80%的F1%,对71.70%. 私人宽度256提高到9.49M,达到75.27%. 这些结果共同凸显了多凯利聚合和共享预测的互补效益:前者丰富了滑动层的表示,而后者则比特定类的预测器实现更高的参数效率更强的分类.

blocks.en: 5.2 Mean versus Learned Query Aggregation
blocks.zh: 5.2 平均与学到的查询汇总

blocks.en: We next investigate whether learned query aggregation improves performance over simple mean pooling. Fig. 6 shows that attention and gated pooling reduced F1 from 77.80% to 75.25% and 74.51%, respectively, corresponding to decreases of 2.55 and 3.29 pp. Meanwhile, forgetting increased by 2.51 and 2.78 pp, indicating weaker retention of previously learned classes. Together, these results demonstrate the advantage of mean aggregation over learned query weighting, achieving stronger classification and knowledge retention with a simpler aggregation mechanism.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们调查 所学到的查询汇总是否比简单的平均集合提高了性能。 图6显示,注意力和门式集合分别将F1从77.80%减少到75.25%和74.51%,相应减少了2.55和3.29页。 同时,忘记增加了2.51和2.78页,表明以前学习的班级保留率较低。 这些结果共同表明,平均汇总比学习到的查询权重有优势,通过更简单的汇总机制实现更强有力的分类和知识保留。

blocks.en: 5.3 Contribution of Pairwise Scoring
blocks.zh: 5.3 对等分数的贡献

blocks.en: We further investigate whether pairwise interactions between class representations improve incremental learning performance. Fig. 7 shows that pairwise scoring reduced F1 from 77.80% to 76.42% on GigaPath, while increasing forgetting by 1.84 pp and model size from 1.230M to 1.361M parameters. In contrast, it improved F1 by 1.32, 1.30 and 4.89 pp with projected CONCH, hierarchical CONCH and ConvNeXt, respectively. Together, these results suggest that the benefit of pairwise scoring depends on the feature representation and training configuration, while the simpler unary predictor offers better performance and parameter efficiency under the matched GigaPath setting.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查班级代表之间的双向互动是否改善了渐进的学习业绩。 费格。 7显示双向积分在Gigapath上将F1从77.80%降低到76.42%,同时将忘却的分数增加1.84pp,模型大小从1.230M提高到1.361M参数. 与此相对照,它分别将F1改进了1.32、1.30和4.89页,并预测了CONCH、等级CONCH和ConvNEXt。 这些结果加在一起表明,双向评分的好处取决于特征表现和培训配置,而简单的无线预测器在匹配的Gigapath设置下提供更好的性能和参数效率.

blocks.en: 5.4 Attention Stability and Predictive Retention
blocks.zh: 5.4 稳定和预期保留

blocks.en: We next investigate how freezing old queries, knowledge distillation (KD) and replay supervision contribute to knowledge retention. Tab. 3 shows that freezing old queries improved F1 from 77.51% to 77.80% and reduced forgetting by 0.31 pp, indicating a modest benefit from stable attention. Removing KD reduced F1 by 1.87 pp and increased forgetting by 1.28 pp. More notably, removing replay CE caused F1 to drop to 30.01%, with forgetting increasing from 13.12 to 66.85 pp. Removing both replay losses yielded 40.35% F1 and 52.13 pp forgetting, while new recall remained above 94% in both settings. Together, these results highlight the importance of replay supervision for preserving earlier classes, with query freezing and KD providing additional stability. Stable attention alone is insufficient to prevent catastrophic forgetting without explicit old-class supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将调查冻结旧的询问、知识蒸馏和重播监督如何有助于知识保留。 标签。 3 显示冻结的旧查询将F1从77.51%提高到77.80%,并减少遗忘0.31页,表明稳定关注的受益不大。 删除KD后将F1减少1.87页,并增加遗忘1.28页. 更值得注意的是,移除重播CE导致F1下降至30.01%,而忘记从13.12页增加到66.85页. 取消重播损失的40.35% F1和52.13页都忘记了,而新的重播在两种情况下都保持在94%以上。 这些结果共同突出表明,必须重新发挥监督作用,以保留较早的分类,同时冻结查询和提供更多的稳定性。 仅靠稳定的关注不足以防止在没有明确的老式监督下发生灾难性的遗忘。

blocks.en: 5.5 Effect of Task Order on Query Freezing
blocks.zh: 5.5 任务命令对查询冻结的影响

blocks.en: We further investigate whether class order changes the retention benefit of freezing old queries. Tab. 4 shows that freezing improved reverse-order F1 by 0.70 pp and old recall by 1.17 pp, with 1.11 pp less forgetting, whereas continued updating increased new recall by 1.92 pp. In the forward order, updating improved F1 by 0.11 pp and old recall by 0.85 pp but reduced new recall by 1.26 pp. Together, these results show how freezing and continued adaptation shift the balance between old-class retention and new-class acquisition, revealing an order-dependent trade-off that is obscured when results are pooled across class orders.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查阶级命令是否改变了冻结旧查询的留存利益. 标签。 4 显示,F1逆序的冻结改进为0.70页,旧的召回为1.17页,1.11页较少忘记,而继续更新则增加新的召回为1.92页。 在前置顺序中,更新改进后的F1以0.11pp,旧召回以0.85pp,但新召回则减少1.26pp. 这些结果表明,冻结和持续适应如何转移了旧式保留和新式购置之间的平衡,揭示了一种依赖订单的取舍,当结果在类别订单之间汇集时,这种取舍就变得模糊不清。

5.6 Replay Supervision and Distillation
blocks.zh: 5.6 重播监督和消化

blocks.en: We finally investigate how replay supervision influences the effectiveness of knowledge distillation (KD) in incremental learning. Fig. 8 shows that KD improved F1 by 1.87 pp with replay CE but reduced it by 10.34 pp without replay CE, yielding a 12.21-pp interaction consistent across both class orders. Without replay CE, KD also reduced old recall by 15.07 pp and increased forgetting by 14.72 pp, indicating substantial degradation in knowledge retention. While replay CE directly distinguishes old classes from newly introduced competitors, KD preserves relative probabilities among old classes [ 3 , 26 ] . Together, these results establish replay CE as the primary component for preserving earlier classes, with KD providing complementary benefits when combined with explicit historical supervision.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们调查了重播监督如何影响知识蒸馏在渐进学习中的有效性。 图8显示,KD将F1改进为1.87页,带有重播CE,但又在不重播CE的情况下将其减少10.34页,产生12.21-pp的相互作用,贯穿两个类的订单. 不重播CE,KD还将旧回忆减少15.07页,并增加遗忘14.72页,表明知识保留方面的严重退化. 在重播CE直接区分老阶层与新引进的竞争对手的同时,KD保留了老阶层之间的相对概率[3,26]. 这些结果共同将CE作为保留早期类别的主要组成部分,而KD在与明确的历史监督相结合的情况下提供互补的好处。

blocks.en: 5.7 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5.7 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: EviSlide-MIL advances class-incremental WSI classification by combining multi-query pooling, parameter-efficient shared prediction, and replay-supervised knowledge retention. Despite these improvements, evaluation remains limited to eight TCGA subtypes and four incremental stages, with performance varying across feature representations and training configurations. The reliance on frozen encoders and stored patient features also limits adaptability and introduces storage and privacy considerations. Future work will explore longer and task-free learning streams [ 29 ] , adaptive feature learning and privacy-aware replay. External multi-institutional validation is needed to assess site-specific shifts [ 30 ] and the balance between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition.
blocks.zh: EviSlide-MIL通过结合多query集合,参数高效共享预测,以及重播监督的知识保留,推进类-增量WSI分类. 尽管取得了这些改进,评价仍限于八个TCGA子类型和四个递增阶段,各专题说明和培训组合的业绩各不相同。 对冷冻编码器和存储病人特征的依赖也限制了适应性,引入了存储和隐私的考虑. 未来工作将探索较长且无任务的学习流[29],适应性特征学习和对隐私的认知重放. 需要外部多机构验证,以评估特定地点的变化[30]以及知识保留和新级获取之间的平衡。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented EviSlide-MIL, a class-incremental WSI classification framework that integrates multi-query pooling, shared prediction, and replay-supervised knowledge retention. EviSlide-MIL achieved the highest final F1 in three of four evaluated settings, demonstrating strong classification performance and reduced catastrophic forgetting. Extensive ablations further demonstrated the benefits of each proposed component. Furthermore, EviSlide-MIL shows the potential for scalable and continuously evolving computational pathology systems, holding broader impact for developing adaptable, efficient pathology AI systems.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了EviSlide-MIL,这是一个类递增的WSI分类框架,它整合了多凯利集合,共享预测,以及重播监督的知识保留. EviSlide-MIL在4个被评价的设置中,有3个实现了最高的最终F1,显示出强大的分类性能,减少了灾难性的遗忘. 广泛的细节进一步表明了每个拟议构成部分的好处。 此外,EviSlide-MIL还显示了可扩展和不断演变的计算病理系统的潜力,为发展适应性强、高效的病理AI系统提供了更广泛的影响。

blocks.en: S1 Data and reproducible training protocol
blocks.zh: S1 数据和可复制的培训协议

blocks.en: The benchmark uses eight TCGA subtypes: lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC), kidney renal clear-cell carcinoma (KIRC), kidney chromophobe carcinoma (KICH), esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC) and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC). Breast and esophageal cases are selected by these diagnoses in the source tables; renal labels follow TCGA-KIRC/KICH membership. Patients are identified by the first three TCGA barcode components, and all slides from a patient form one evaluation unit. Methods share the inherited patient partitions. Before training, we check training/validation disjointness and feature-file availability.
blocks.zh: 基准使用8种TCGA亚型:肺腺癌(LUAD),肺积聚细胞癌(LUSC),侵入性胶囊癌(IDC),侵入性卵巢癌(ILC),肾清细胞癌(KIRC),肾染色体癌(KICH),食精细胞癌(EAC)和食精细胞癌(ESCC). 乳房和食道病例通过这些诊断在来源表中进行选择;肾脏标签遵循TCGA-KIRC/KICH成员身份. 患者由前三个TCGA条码组件识别,所有来自患者的幻灯片组成一个评价单元. 方法共享继承的患者分区. 在培训前,我们检查培训/鉴定的脱节和特征文件的可用性。

blocks.en: CONCH ViT-B/16 v1.0 extraction uses bicubic resizing, a 448 × 448 448\times 448 center crop, RGB conversion and ImageNet normalization. Projected CONCH uses the contrastive projection and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization, giving 512-dimensional features with the same 2,048/4,096 patch caps. Hierarchical CONCH retains unnormalized 512-dimensional pre-contrastive fine and parent features. Each region supplies an 8 × 8 8\times 8 grid of 512 × 512 512\times 512 fine patches and a parent image resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Region extraction targets a 4096 × 4096 4096\times 4096 field at 0.5 ​ μ 0.5\,\mu m per pixel with half-field stride. A thumbnail mask requires saturation above 0.08 and mean intensity between 20 and 235; accepted regions contain at least 15% masked tissue. Regions follow a seeded hash order, independent of labels and predictions. For sparse slides, extraction uses a denser stride and, when needed, a halved physical field rescaled to the same pixel dimensions. Flat bags deduplicate overlapping patch origins; hierarchical bags retain complete regions.

blocks.en: Main-text Tab. 1 compares complete systems in four input/training groups, preserving each competitor’s architecture and adaptation mechanism. ABMIL and the current GigaPath controls have verified input and sampling records. For historical CLAM, PMP and TransMIL, incomplete feature checksums leave cache identity with the current reference unverified; these comparisons are descriptive. Input information and computation remain method specific even with a shared encoder or current-data budget.
blocks.zh: 主要文字标签1比较了四个投入/培训组的完整系统,保留了每个竞争者的架构和适应机制。 ABMIL和目前的Gigapath控制已经核实了输入和取样记录。 对于历史的CLAM,PMP和TransMIL,不完全的特性校验和会留下缓存身份,当前引用未经验证;这些比较是描述性的. 即使有共享编码器或当前数据预算,输入信息和计算方法仍然是具体的。

blocks.en: CLAM-SB with AKD, CLAM-MB with replay/KD, TransMIL with replay/KD and ABMIL with replay/KD combine MIL architectures with continual-learning mechanisms. ABMIL uses gated-attention pooling, a width-512 embedding and width-256 attention network, with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} throughout. Fixed-update controls use 1,200 updates per stage and terminal checkpoints. TransMIL uses AdamW in place of its published Lookahead–RAdam/epoch recipe. PMP retains pseudo-bag memory selection and proportional independent replay updates; features, patient protocol, optimizer, accumulation, instance supervision and checkpoint selection differ from its published recipe.
blocks.zh: CLAM-SB配有AKD,CLAM-MB配有回放/KD,TransMIL配有回放/KD,ABMIL配有回放/KD配有MIL架构与持续学习机制结合. ABMIL使用门式注意集,宽度-512嵌入和宽度-256注意网,全程学习率10−4 10^{-4}. 固定更新控制每个阶段和终端检查站使用1 200个更新。 TransMIL使用AdamW来代替其出版的Lookahead-RAdam/时代食谱. PMP保留伪包内存选择和比例化的独立重播更新;特性,病人协议,优化者,积累,实例监督和检查点选择与其公布的食谱不同.

blocks.en: QPMIL-VL and KMP-MIL supplement the shared visual features with frozen text towers, prompts, pools and calibration, without patient replay. KMP-MIL retrieves from its universal class-incremental pool without a true task identifier. Each stage uses 1,200 updates and sixteen current bags per update. EviSlide-MIL accumulates per-bag gradients with AdamW and patient replay/KD. QPMIL-VL and KMP-MIL use joint minibatch objectives and Adam at 0.001 and 0.005, respectively, with weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . All use terminal checkpoints.
blocks.zh: QPMIL-VL和KMP-MIL以冷冻的文本塔,提示,池和校准来补充共享的视觉功能,不进行病人重播. KMP-MIL 从其通用的类递增池中回收,但没有真正的任务标识符. 每个阶段每次更新使用1200个更新,16个当前袋. EviSlide-MIL用亚当W和病人重播/KD来积累每袋梯度. QPMIL-VL和KMP-MIL分别使用0.001和0.005的组合小批量目标与亚当,重量衰减5×10−4 5\Times 10×4}. 都使用终端检查站.

blocks.en: CooMIL concatenates raw fine and parent features in its MIL branch and uses normalized projected sums in its text-conditioned branch. It retains frozen specialists, prompts and fourteen training centers per task, predicts a task and then masks classes. EviSlide-MIL directly scores all seen classes from transformed fine patches and retains patient replay. Both use 1,200 updates with four accumulated current bags per update. CooMIL stores specialists, text and centers as persistent state; its patient-replay wrapper is empty. Context, text, experts, routing and processing change together in these comparisons.
blocks.zh: CooMIL在其MIL分支中将原始精细和母体特征加成,并在其文本条件分支中使用正常的预计金额。 它保留了冻结的专家、提示和每个任务的14个培训中心,预测一项任务,然后进行口罩课。 EviSlide-MIL直接从变形的精细补丁中给所有所见课程打分,并保留病人的重播. 两者都使用1200个更新,每次更新四个累积的当前袋. CooMIL将专家、文字和中心储存为持久状态;它的病人-重播包装是空的。 背景、文本、专家、路线和处理在这些比较中一起变化。

blocks.en: ConSlide uses fine and parent features, ten first-task self-supervised epochs, region-buffer augmentation and continuous Adam state. Main-text Tab. 1 uses Adam at 10 − 5 10^{-5} , single-bag updates and 1,100 regions under 256 MiB. EviSlide-MIL uses fine features, stage-reset AdamW, four-bag accumulation and its 60-patient memory under 48 MiB. The final accumulation batch is normalized by its actual size.
blocks.zh: ConSlide使用精细和母特性,十个第一任务自我监督的时代,区域缓冲增强和连续亚当状态. 主文本 Tab. 1 使用 Adam at 10 − 5 10 → 5 }, 单包更新和 1 100 个区域在 256 MiB 下. EviSlide-MIL 使用精细特性, 舞台重置 AdamW , 四包堆积及其 60 病人记忆在 48 MiB 下. 最后一批积累量按实际规模正常化.

blocks.en: Both methods use complete-epoch current-slide shuffles and at most fifty supervised epochs, with independent stopping and checkpoint selection. Selection minimizes all-seen-class slide cross-entropy on the current-stage validation cohort from zero-based epoch five. Ties save the model and reset patience; a worse result stops training when patience reaches ten or the epoch exceeds ten. ConSlide restores the best model while retaining terminal Adam moments. Independent stopping and selection permit different training durations and exposure despite the shared sequence of early epochs.
blocks.zh: 这两种方法都采用完全划时代的流滑式洗牌,最多50个受监督的时空,独立停靠和选择检查站. 选择可以将当前阶段验证组上的全视类幻灯片跨切切变最小化 。 捆绑拯救模型并重置耐心;当耐心达到10或时代超过10时,更糟糕的结果会停止训练. 康斯利德在保留终端亚当瞬间的同时恢复最佳模型. 独立的停课和选择允许不同的培训期限和接触,尽管早期时间顺序相同。

blocks.zh: anc/source_data中的CSV文件包含208个新的轨迹/832级和32个再利用的引用/128级,包括单个折叠/顺序/种子结果,类回顾,资源,源总和,匹配差异和所有96个条件级损失对比. README 将文件映射到表格并定义资源计时器. 缺少遥测是空白的。 时机测量共享硬件的预测器训练,排除编码器提取.

blocks.en: S6 Extended protocol and analysis figures
blocks.zh: S6 扩展协议和分析数字

blocks.en: Fig. S5 provides an additional ILC example alongside the main-text LUSC and LUAD cases.
blocks.zh: 图5. 除主要文本LUSC和LUAD案件外,国际法委员会还提供了另一个例子。

blocks.en: Fig. S5: Additional ground-truth-class attention example: correctly classified ILC. The main paper shows the LUSC and LUAD cases; this panel retains the same four-query layout and shared asinh display scale with raw-attention ticks. Weights retain full 4,096-anchor normalization. Red rings mark unmodified argmax coordinates, including repeats. Lower images show 256 μ \mu m spatial contexts with unverified correspondence to historical feature tiles; scale bars are 50 μ \mu m. These cases visualize model attention; annotation-based tumor-localization accuracy was not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 费格。 S5: 更多地面真相类关注的例子:正确分类的国际法委员会。 主论文显示LUSC和LUAD的大小写;这个面板保留了相同的四缸布局,并用原意勾选来共享asinh显示比例. 重量保持了完全的4,096-锚定态. 红色环标未修改的矩形坐标,包括重复. 下部图像显示256 μ \mu m的空间上下文,与历史特征瓦片的对应关系未经验证;比例栏为50 μ \mu m. 这些病例可视化模型关注;基于注释的肿瘤局部化精度没有被评价.

blocks.en: The quantitative figures summarize development-validation conditions, with patients reused across orders and seeds. Sec. S3 defines the controls, Sec. S4 gives supporting contrasts, and Sec. S7 reports held-out results.
blocks.zh: 定量数字总结了发展验证条件,患者在订单和种子之间重复使用. S3中Sc定义了控件,S4中Sc给出了支持对比,S7中Sc报告被搁置的结果.

blocks.en: Fig. S6 resolves development performance by subtype in both task orders.
blocks.zh: Fig. S6在两个任务订单中按子类型解决开发性能.

blocks.en: Fig. S6: Development subtype recalls. Means over eight conditions per order. Both panels retain the same biological subtype order and 0–100% color scale; gray denotes unseen classes. Final-stage values are annotated, and orders reuse validation patients.
blocks.zh: 费格。 S6:开发子类型召回. 意味着每个订单超过8个条件. 两个面板都保留了相同的生物亚型顺序和0-100%的颜色尺度;灰色表示看不见的类. 最后阶段的数值是附加说明的,并命令再利用验证病人。

blocks.en: S7 Evaluation on held-out TCGA patients
blocks.zh: S7 对被扣留的TCGA病人的评价

blocks.en: Tab. S4 gives the subtype composition of the held-out cohort introduced in main-text Sec. 4.1 . Patient identity uses the first three TCGA barcode components. We verified the four original split manifests against their archived hashes for both model families. Test membership was identical across all five fold columns and had no patient overlap with the full 1,523-patient development pool. Labels were consistent within patients, slide identifiers were unique across stages, and every included slide had its original cache. All 394 feature files passed dimension, coordinate, finite-value and SHA-256 checks. Cache hashes were distinct within Test and from the sealed development inventory. The audit retained the complete cohort.
blocks.zh: Tab.S4给出了主文本Sec.4.1中引入的被搁置组的子类型组成。 患者身份使用前三个TCGA条码组件. 我们核实了四个原始的拆分清单 与他们存档的散列,两个模范家庭。 所有五个折叠柱的测试成员相同,患者与1 523个完整的病人发展池没有重叠。 标签在患者内部是一致的,幻灯片标识符是不同阶段独有的,每个包含的幻灯片都有其原始缓存. 所有394个特征文件都经过了维度,坐标,限值和SHA-256检查. 缓存散列在测试和密封开发清单中是不同的。 审计保留了全体人员。

blocks.en: Tab. S4: Held-out cohort shared by all methods and conditions.
blocks.zh: 标签。 S4:所有方法和条件都共享的被搁置组群。

blocks.en: Each method contributes 16 previously trained trajectories from folds 2–5, forward/reverse orders and seeds 60/61, with four terminal checkpoints per trajectory. We verified all 128 checkpoint receipts and model hashes. No training, calibration, threshold fitting or model selection used these test patients. Before test inference, a development check on 64 patients and 103 slides reproduced all 7,680 archived patient probability entries exactly. Inference then used the same scoring code, model-specific input preparation and original GigaPath cache. Bag selection and inference follow the main-text protocol. Each stage included all test patients from the subtypes introduced by that stage.
blocks.zh: 每种方法都提供了16个以前受过训练的轨迹,从折叠式2-5、向前/逆向订单和种子60/61,每个轨迹有4个终点检查站。 我们核实了所有128个检查站的收据和散列模型。 没有使用这些测试病人的培训、校准、阈值配置或模型选择。 在测试推断前,对64名患者和103张幻灯片的发育检查完全复制了所有7,680个存档的患者概率条目. 然后推论使用相同的评分代码,模型特定输入准备和原版Gigapath缓存. 包的选择和推论遵循主文本协议. 每个阶段都包括来自该阶段引入的亚型的所有测试病人.

blocks.en: Tab. S5 reports macro-recall across stages.
blocks.zh: S5报告跨阶段的宏观召回。

blocks.en: Tab. S5: Held-out macro-recall (%), eight conditions per order. E: EviSlide-MIL; A: ABMIL + Replay/KD. Stage-wise evaluation covers the complete set of seen classes.
blocks.zh: Tab. S5:被搁置的宏召回(%),每个订单有8个条件. E:EviSlide-MIL;A:ABMIL+重播/KD. 分阶段评价涵盖整套见习班。

blocks.en: The estimands and resampling count follow main-text Sec. 4.1 . We used NumPy PCG64 with seed 20261115. Each subtype-stratified patient draw is shared across both methods, all conditions and applicable stages. Each draw recomputes macro-F1, recalls and the peak-recall term in forgetting before equally averaging conditions and forming paired differences. Percentile intervals condition on the fitted models and fixed class composition. The same draws yield the order-specific estimates in Tab. S6 .
blocks.zh: 动画和重样计数跟随主文第4.1节. 我们使用了NumPy PCG64,种子2026115. 每个亚型分级的病人图画在两种方法、所有条件和适用阶段都共享。 每个绘图重算宏-F1,回顾和峰值重计术语,在同等平均条件之前忘记,形成对称差异. 装配型号和固定班级组成的百分比间隔条件。 同样的绘图得出Tab中特定订单的估计数。 S6号.

blocks.en: Tab. S6: Held-out paired differences (EviSlide-MIL minus ABMIL + Replay/KD), with patient-bootstrap 95% CIs. Means average eight conditions per order. F1 is a percentage; forgetting and paired differences are measured in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 标签。 S6: 被搁置的配对差异(EviSlide-MIL 减去ABMIL + Replay/KD),患者-bootstrap 95% CIS. 意味着每个订单平均有八个条件. F1是一个百分比;遗忘和配对差异以百分点衡量.

blocks.en: The marginal 95% intervals for final macro-F1 were 72.25–79.22% for EviSlide-MIL and 60.43–65.85% for ABMIL with replay/KD; main-text Sec. 4.4 reports their pooled means and paired effects. Tab. S7 provides the forward-order subtype recalls.
blocks.zh: EviSlide-MIL和ABMIL的中间值分别为72.25-79.22%和60.43-65.85%,分别是重播/KD;主文第4.4节报告了它们的集合手段和配对效果。 Tab. S7提供了前序子类型召回.

blocks.en: Tab. S7: Forward held-out subtype recall (%), averaged over eight conditions. E: EviSlide-MIL; A: ABMIL + Replay/KD. Dashes indicate subtypes not yet introduced at that stage.
blocks.zh: 标签。 S7: 前置悬浮子类型召回(%),平均超过8个条件. E:EviSlide-MIL;A:ABMIL+重播/KD. Dashes表示该阶段尚未引入的子类型.

blocks.en: Tab. S8 gives the corresponding reverse-order outcomes.
blocks.zh: Tab. S8给出了相应的反序结果.

blocks.en: Tab. S8: Reverse held-out subtype recall (%), averaged over eight conditions. E: EviSlide-MIL; A: ABMIL + Replay/KD. Dashes indicate subtypes not yet introduced at that stage.
blocks.zh: 标签。 S8: 反向搁置的子类型召回(%),平均超过8个条件. E:EviSlide-MIL;A:ABMIL+重播/KD. Dashes表示该阶段尚未引入的子类型.

blocks.en: The archived p0_test_analysis.json records all 32 method-specific trajectories, 128 stage summaries, subtype recalls, per-class forgetting, confusion matrices and paired intervals. Provenance fields bind the checkpoint lock, audited test manifest, prediction artifact and analysis code by SHA-256. An independent calculation from the saved patient predictions reproduced every condition’s metrics and the pooled and order-specific bootstrap intervals. The archived aggregate contains no patient identifiers. The project CSVs cover development experiments; the held-out JSON and patient-level predictions are not included in this source package.
blocks.zh: 存档的p0_test_analysis.json记录了所有32个方法特有的轨迹,128个阶段摘要,子类型召回,每类遗忘,混淆矩阵和配对间隔. SHA-256对检查点锁、经审计的测试清单、预测文物和分析代码绑定了证据。 从节省下来的病人预测中独立计算得出每个病情的衡量标准以及集合和特定顺序的靴子间隔。 存档总数中没有任何病人识别资料。 项目CSV涵盖开发实验;被搁置的JSON和患者水平预测不包含在这个源包中.
